notes: analyze.sas imports ev_sales.csv via PROC IMPORT from a hardcoded SAS OnDemand path, then runs PROC PRINT/CONTENTS/MEANS/MEANS NMISS/SGPLOT. For a self-contained run the PROC IMPORT is replaced by a DATA step building ev_sales (identical 9 column names) from a faithful 42-row sample of the repo's own EV sales data (China/Germany/Norway, 2010-2023); the author's analysis PROCs run unchanged. Deterministic across two POSTs.
